name: nearby-api
description: Nearby REST API (Code-First: the OpenAPI spec is generated from zod schemas)

scripts.mcp:generate: npm ci --prefix tools/mcp-generator && tools/mcp-generator/node_modules/.bin/openapi-mcp-generator --input docs/api/openapi-generated.yaml --output src/mcp --server-name nearby-api-mcp --force && npm install --prefix src/mcp --save-dev --save-exact shx@0.3.4
scripts.mcp:build: npm ci --prefix src/mcp && npm run build --prefix src/mcp
scripts.test:coverage: nest build && mcr -o coverage -n "All tests" node --test "tests/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:coverage:unit: nest build && mcr -o coverage -n "Unit tests" node --test "tests/unit/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.docs:coverage: nest build && mcr -o docs/testing/coverage/unit -n "Unit tests" node --test "tests/unit/**/*.test.ts" && mcr -o docs/testing/coverage/all -n "All tests" node --test "tests/**/*.test.ts"
